Agriculture Infrastructure Fund.benefit: 3% interest subvention and credit guarantee up to Rs. 2 crore for post-harvest management infrastructure.
Agriculture Infrastructure Fund.eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, Marketing Cooperative Societies, Self Help Groups, and agri-entrepreneurs.
Agriculture Infrastructure Fund.how_to_apply: Apply through the online AIF portal or approach your commercial bank/cooperative bank.

PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi.benefit: Rs. 6000 per year transferred directly to the bank accounts in three equal installments of Rs. 2000.
PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi.eligibility: All landholding farmers' families in the country, subject to exclusion criteria like institutional landholders and high-income earners.
PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi.how_to_apply: Apply via PM-Kisan portal, CSCs, or local revenue officers (Patwari).

ATMA.benefit: Facilitates technology dissemination, farmer training, exposure visits, and demonstrations at the district level.
ATMA.eligibility: All active farmers looking to upgrade their farming techniques and adopt new technology.
ATMA.how_to_apply: Contact the district ATMA office or Block Technology Manager.

AGMARKNET.benefit: Provides daily prices and arrivals of agricultural commodities in wholesale markets across India.
AGMARKNET.eligibility: Open for all farmers and traders to view market trends and make informed selling decisions.
AGMARKNET.how_to_apply: Access the AGMARKNET portal or download the app; no formal application required.

Horticulture.component_name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
Horticulture.benefit: Financial assistance for area expansion, cold storage, greenhouses, and planting material creation.
Horticulture.eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, and cooperatives willing to cultivate fruits, vegetables, and flowers.
Horticulture.how_to_apply: Submit proposal to State Horticulture Mission or District Horticulture Officer.

Online Pesticide Registration.benefit: Streamlines the process of registering, importing, and manufacturing safe crop protection chemicals.
Online Pesticide Registration.how_to_apply: Apply online through the CIB&RC portal (Crop Assessment Portal).

Plant Quarantine Clearance.benefit: Prevents introduction of exotic pests and diseases and facilitates safe export/import of agricultural commodities.
Plant Quarantine Clearance.eligibility: Exporters and importers of plants and plant materials.
Plant Quarantine Clearance.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Plant Quarantine Information System (PQIS).

DBT in Agriculture.benefit: Ensures direct transfer of subsidies (like seeds and machinery) into the Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of farmers.
DBT in Agriculture.eligibility: Any farmer availing government subsidies mapped to the DBT portal.
DBT in Agriculture.how_to_apply: Link Bank Account to Aadhaar and register on the State Agri DBT portal.

Pradhanmantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana.component_name: Per Drop More Crop / Micro Irrigation
Pradhanmantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana.benefit: Subsidy provided for installing drip and sprinkler irrigation systems to improve water use efficiency.
Pradhanmantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana.eligibility: All farmers, preferably those in water-stressed areas.
Pradhanmantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana.how_to_apply: Apply online on the respective state micro-irrigation portal or through the district agriculture office.

Kisan Call Center.benefit: Immediate agricultural advice from experts in local languages via toll-free number 1800-180-1551.
Kisan Call Center.how_to_apply: Dial 1800-180-1551 from any mobile or landline network.

mKisan.benefit: Receive personalized agricultural advisories via SMS directly to your mobile phone based on crop and location.
mKisan.eligibility: Any farmer possessing a mobile phone.
mKisan.how_to_apply: Register mobile number on the mKisan portal or send USSD codes to opt-in.

Jaivik Kheti.benefit: Connects organic farmers directly with buyers and promotes bulk/retail sale of certified organic produce.
Jaivik Kheti.eligibility: Farmers certified under PGS-India or NPOP.
Jaivik Kheti.how_to_apply: Register as a seller on the Jaivik Kheti online portal.

e-Nam.benefit: A pan-India electronic trading portal that networks existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market.
e-Nam.eligibility: Farmers wishing to sell their produce directly directly to buyers across India.
e-Nam.how_to_apply: Register at the nearest integrated APMC mandi or online through the e-NAM app/portal.

Soil Health Card.benefit: Provides crop-wise recommendations of nutrients and fertilizers required to improve yield based on soil testing.
Soil Health Card.eligibility: All farmers are periodically issued these cards by the state government.
Soil Health Card.how_to_apply: Contact the nearest soil testing laboratory or district agriculture officer.

Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana.benefit: Provides comprehensive insurance cover against failure of the crop, helping stabilize farmer income. Premium is as low as 1.5% - 2%.
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana.eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including tenant farmers and sharecroppers.
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana.how_to_apply: Apply through the PMFBY portal, CSC centres, or the bank branches granting KCC loans.
